verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's official CLI has a documented `bw serve` mode that exposes the vault as a local RESTful API (Vault Management API) an agent can query for TOTP codes and items, so no screen-scraping is needed. A community report confirms the CLI returns passwords and current TOTP codes programmatically, and a first-party MCP server also completed a local stdio handshake. missing for 10: a verbatim first-party doc excerpt describing the `bw serve` endpoints, and hands-on evidence of an agent querying the local endpoint (the runtime probe only confirmed install and version).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can expose the vault through a local programmatic endpoint an agent can query for codes and secrets without screen-scraping the app

citations.quote: the CLI whose documented `bw serve` mode exposes the whole vault as a local RESTful API (Vault Management API) an agent can query for TOTP codes and items.
